jobs_results.title: Senior Electronics Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Description:
Whitewall Solutions develops software and hardware to create smart and connected products. By developing technology to provide intelligence and connectivity, we allow products to be monitored, controlled, optimized and transformed into autonomous ones. If you want to be part of a growing team and have a career full of motivation and creativity, we await your request.

Responsibilities:

Requirements:
• Use of electronic design programs:
KiCAD.
• 5 years of experience
• Possibility of remote work
• Work with your own computer equipment
• Python, C
• Knowledge of: BDD, DDD, TDD
• Experience with embedded Linux systems
• Experience with version control tools - GIT

Offer:
• Contract for work and service until the end of the project
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: .NET Senior | Hibrido
jobs_results.description:
Si dominas .NET, en ALTEN encontrarás el equipo y el proyecto que lleven tu carrera profesional al siguiente nivel.

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, si tienes 3 años de experiencia o más con .NET, nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Te unes a nuestro #WelcomeHome? ¡Sigue leyendo!

¿Qué buscamos?

Diferentes perfiles para desarrollo senior y para gestionar el equipo como Tech Lead.

- Desarrollador con experiencia en .Net Core, ASP.NET y C#.

- Conocimientos de base de datos relacionales (SQL y PostgreSQL) como no relacionales (MongoDB o Redis).

- Que haya trabajado con arquitecturas API Rest – servicios web SOAP y microservicios.

- Experiencia con testing unitario.

- Conocimiento de patrones como DDD y principios SOLID.

- Gestión previa de equipos para las vacantes de TL.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?

- Posición híbrida en... Sevilla (San Juan de Aznalfarache).

- Formar parte de una gran empresa competitiva y en continuo crecimiento.

- Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.

- Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.

- Beneficios sociales y plan de compensación flexible.

- Retribución competitiva.

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que tenemos una facturación mundial de más de 3.650 millones de euros, contamos con 52.700 profesionales y estamos presentes en más de 30 países.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate

jobs_results.title: Ingenieros senior para segunda carrera profesional en en Grupo...
jobs_results.description:
En Grupo Aire Limpio, que comprende las compañías @Commtech, @Ambisalud, @Acsos y @Aire Limpio, buscamos profesionales con experiencia que estén interesados en emprender una segunda carrera profesional en un entorno estimulante. Damos gran valor a la experiencia acumulada, preferiblemente aquellos profesionales con una carrera y madurez profesional dilatada con conocimientos en instalaciones mecánicas o eléctricas, facility management, oficina técnica, construcción, montajes, puestas en marcha, mantenimiento, sostenibilidad y energía. que estén buscando un rol significativo en la siguiente etapa de su carrera profesional.

Ofrecemos:
• Oportunidades de integrarse en nuestras áreas de ingeniería, consultoría, commissioning e instalaciones.
• Un rol que permite contribuir con su experiencia y habilidades en proyectos significativos y sostenibles.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia de más de 20 años en áreas relevantes.
• Habilidades de liderazgo y gestión de proyectos.
• Interés en la... sostenibilidad y tecnologías limpias.

Si estás interesado en continuar tu desarrollo profesional en un entorno que aprecia y utiliza la experiencia senior para impulsar la innovación y la eficiencia, por favor envía tu currículum y una carta de presentación a airelimpio@airelimpio.com

Esperamos que puedas unirte a nosotros para afrontar los desafíos de hoy y de mañana en el campo de las instalaciones y la sostenibilidad energética

jobs_results.title: Senior UI Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Gran vacante Senior Engineer en proceso de contratación Gran vacante Senior Engineer en proceso de contratación sage careers Portal del solicit ante

Información sobre el trabajo:
Senior Engineer

Información completa del trabajo.
Nombre de vacante Senior Engineer Descripción We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UI Engineer (ideally full stack or with backend knowledge) to join our Service Fabric team in Barcelona.

Service Fabric is a technology platform that enables Sage to deliver common capabilities required across multiple Sage cloud or cloud-connected products.

As a Senior Engineer, you are going to collaborate in the design, develop and delivery of high-quality products and services that exceed customers’ or business partners’ expectations.

You will be part of a team inside Sage’s global Service Fabric organisation, located in multiple countries around the globe. You’ll be part of a dynamic team focused on integration and enablement activities. Responsabilidades principal... es Your responsibilities will be to:

• Design and develop user interfaces for web applications (mobile friendly), using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related front-end frameworks such as React and/or Angular

• Collaborate with designers, product managers, and back-end developers to ensure a seamless user experience

• Translate UI/UX design wireframes into high-quality code

• Develop reusable UI components and libraries

• Optimize user interfaces for performance and responsiveness

• Mentor and lead other engineers in the team

• Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality standards

• Improve code quality by implementing best practices and design patterns

• Communicate with other teams to understand requirements and propose solutions

We would love to meet you if you:

• Have developed using a variety of technologies, with experience in front-end frameworks - React and/or Angular.

• Hands-on experience in .NET backend development. Knowledge of Node.

JS

• Keen interest in learning new programming languages and tools.

• You enjoy reading code and fully understanding the environment in which it runs, from the network stack to the back-end storage layers and everything in between.

• Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment

• Experience working with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

• Familiarity with development and deployment of cloud-based products

Independently of your technical profile and background, we put value on collaboration and communication skills, displaying an agile mindset and having reasonable amounts of autonomy and accountability.

Why you would love to join us?

Impact:
You’ll be working alongside a tremendous team of highly skilled engineers on products that make a real impact on our customers.

Culture:

You will be working in a multicultural and diverse environment.

Environment:
Fantastic tech environment, using the best of breed and cutting-edge technologies.

Community:
Make a difference to communities we live and work in, with your 5 volunteer days every year. How we are making a difference

Continuous Development:
Unlimited access to Pluralsight, Linkedin Learning and Sage University.

Career Growth:
Long-term prospects for a professional career. Access to Talent Marketplace, an internal system that uses artificial intelligence to create a clear path for growth.

The flexible Human Work approach will provide you an opportunity to unlock all forms of flexibility (mode, location, and time).

Brand office space, locates at the heart of Barcelona’s 22@tech district, with great transport links.

Reduced working hours in the summer.

Flexible benefits that suit your needs.

Ready to take up this challenge? Apply today or contact us for more information.

From our colleagues delivering ground-breaking solutions to the customers who use them: people have helped us grow for more than forty years, and people are driving our future as a great SaaS company. We're writing our next chapter. Be part of it!

At Sage, we recognize that the world of work has rapidly shifted over the last few years, particularly how we work. That is why we have committed to working in a hybrid way going forward. Human connection is an essential ingredient of the 4 principles that make up our Flexible Human Work hybrid framework and we want to be transparent in what that looks like when you join our Sage family.

On one hand, our offices will continue to play an important role in our future and serve as a place for spontaneous conversations, connection, collaboration as well as focused time. On the other hand, we have learned to reimagine where and when we work and to unlock that flexibility and innovation for our colleagues offering them the opportunity to work flex across their home, Sage offices or customer sites.

We invite you to join us and help us write our next chapter. Follow us on our social media sites to join in conversations about open…

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, HTML CSS
jobs_results.description:
When you are enjoying content on TV, radio, smartphone, tablet or PC, you are also watching the works of the team that helps put that content right there. The mission of MEDIAGENIX is to enable renowned media companies (e.g. BBC, Disney, Discovery, Paramount) worldwide to bring content to the viewer in the most efficient and future-proof way with the help of our broadcast management system
.

To support media companies in their growth in this fast-paced media world, we deliver innovative software solutions on premise or web-based in the cloud that optimize the life cycle of their content across channels and services.

Be key to this stimulating new journey and help change the game of media operations with state-of-the-art technologies as the new Backend Software Engineer at BeBanjo!

Be Banjo , part of MEDIAGENIX, is the reference non-linear scheduling system. It is well known for developing a software solution that allows some of the world's most successful media companies such as... BBC Studios, ITV and Warner Media to create schedules and plans to manage workflows, rights and metadata simply and efficiently.
Your challenge
• At BeBanjo, developers work in two independent teams:
Project and Product. The Project team takes care of building custom integrations for our clients, while the Product team is responsible for maintaining and implementing new features for our core Products. We are currently hiring for the Projects team
.

These are some of challenges that you, together with the Projects team, work on:
• You're using our own Ruby framework and build an integration to sync our client's data with third parties.
• You're helping new customers on-boarding process by working on data migration plans
, and workflow automations
.
• You're working with the Technical Account Managers on designing solutions for the specific customer demands. You decide on the technical details and estimate the expected effort.
• You keep our components ecosystem at peak performance (i.e. stack up to date, review past design decisions, benchmark and profile, etc).

As a Projects team developer you should expect working with Ruby
,
MySQL
, and several AWS services
: SNS, SQS, AWS Lambda, and Dynamo

DB.
Our wish list
• You have significant experience building digital products of any kind.
• You understand the importance of having a solid test suite
.
• You have some experience with our stack:
Ruby on Rails, Elasticsearch, MySQL,
Vue.js, Hot Wire…
• We use AWS extensively. Any prior experience is considered a plus.
• You live in Spain
.

Next to this, we're looking for someone empathetic and curious, with clear communication skills and a willingness to listen. If you're deeply committed to your work and team success, self-motivated to work independently
, and adept at staying organized and focused, you'll thrive in our international team of talented, considerate individuals!

Don’t rule yourself out if you think you don’t tick all the boxes
. We’re looking for keen learners with a great attitude.
Our offer
• Work from anywhere in Spain with flexible schedules so that you can be there for the people you love, avoid commuting every day, be a nomad, find the environment where you’re most productive, and plan your day exactly how you like it.
• Depending on your experience, the salary range for this position is €45 000 - €55 000 annually.
• An indefinite contract. We value long-term relationships with our staff.
• Great flexibility to enjoy however you prefer your 23 days of annual holidays (in addition to the regular bank holidays).
• Support for your continuing education and professional growth
: books, workshops, conferences…
• An inclusive, supportive, and stable environment where your best work can happen.

Excited? So are we! Take the next step by
applying
below and let us demonstrate the endless possibilities at MEDIAGENIX.

We're already looking forward to meeting you!
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer Junior (60% Remote)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

ENVIRA (www.envira.es) es una compañía, con más de 30 años de experiencia, experta en el desarrollo de soluciones de monitorización de parámetros ambientales y salud estructural en entornos industriales, urbanos y agrícolas, así como en el tratamiento de los datos generados.

Hoy ENVIRA implementa sistemas integrales automáticos de medida de la calidad ambiental y emisiones contaminantes y también diseña y desarrolla dispositivos para redes IOT y plataformas software, en la vanguardia tecnológica, que realizan medidas precisas y analizan múltiples parámetros en entornos de la industria 4.0, Smart Cities y agricultura de precisión.

ENVIRA DS es el sistema de monitorización y control ambiental líder en el mercado español, con más de cien referencias en los sectores tanto público como industrial. ENVIRA DS es una plataforma de Internet Industrial de las Cosas (IIoT) referente en el control de la contaminación y el cálculo de emisiones con amplia implantación en los... sectores de la generación eléctrica, químico, petroquímico, metal, fabricación de cemento y transporte.

¿Qué buscamos?
• Buscamos una persona con conocimientos y al 1 menos año como desarrollador o ingeniero de software.
• Conocimiento y experiencia aplicando técnicas y principios de programación de código limpio: clean code, patrones de diseño, TDD, SOLID, etc.
• Experiencia básica en desarrollo de productos software y el manejo de las herramientas de gestión de los activos como: integración continua, herramientas de testing, repositorios de código, sistemas de automatización de build y gestión de dependencias, etc.
• Titulación en Ingeniería Informática o de Telecomunicaciones o equivalente.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Incorporarte a una empresa estable, con una larga trayectoria en la ingeniería, para el desarrollo de un producto estratégico de la compañía.
• Pertenecer a un equipo autogestionado, junto con perfiles senior con los que aprenderás.
• Participar en el desarrollo de tecnología con una finalidad: avanzar hacia una industria medioambientalmente sostenible, combatiendo el cambio climático.
• Jornada flexible de lunes a jueves y jornada continua los viernes.
• Modelo de trabajo híbrido (60% teletrabajo). La jornada del lunes la dedicamos a trabajar sobre el backlog con el equipo funcional y los viernes nos juntamos para hacer las demos del producto, analizar el avance y planificar la semana.
• 25 días libres: 23 días de vacaciones + nochebuena y nochevieja.
• Jornada de verano.
• Plan de retribución flexible.
• Diferentes opciones a elegir para configurar tu setup de trabajo: portátil, monitor, dock station...
• Presupuesto para formación.
• Rango salarial 24k-28k

• Incorporarte a una empresa estable, con una larga trayectoria en la ingeniería, para el desarrollo de un producto estratégico de la compañía.
• Pertenecer a un equipo autogestionado, junto con perfiles senior con los que aprenderás.
• Participar en el desarrollo de tecnología con una finalidad: avanzar hacia una industria medioambientalmente sostenible, combatiendo el cambio climático.
• Jornada flexible de lunes a jueves y jornada continua los viernes.
• Modelo de trabajo híbrido (60% teletrabajo). La jornada del lunes la dedicamos a trabajar sobre el backlog con el equipo funcional y los viernes nos juntamos para hacer las demos del producto, analizar el avance y planificar la semana.
• 25 días libres: 23 días de vacaciones + nochebuena y nochevieja.
• Jornada de verano.
• Plan de retribución flexible.
• Diferentes opciones a elegir para configurar tu setup de trabajo: portátil, monitor, dock station...
• Presupuesto para formación.
• Rango salarial 24k-28k

jobs_results.title: Fullstack Engineer - .NET​/TypeScript​/Electron​/remote- Spain
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Fullstack Engineer - .NET / TypeScript / Electron (100% remote-friendly within Spain)
Company Description Welcome to the good side of tech ðYou might have heard about us, but with a different name:
Doctoralia or Znany Lekarz. It all started 10 years ago, when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients.

And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management... and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

How does Docplanner Tech fit here?

At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us. And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.

Job Description What will you do with us? Develop and Maintain Server-Side Applications:
Take ownership of the development and maintenance of server-side applications using .NET (C#) and Symfony (PHP). This involves working on both new projects and enhancing existing ones to meet evolving business needs and performance requirements.

Design and Implement APIs and Web Services:
Design and implement robust APIs and web services. Ensure seamless integration between frontend interfaces and backend systems, providing efficient data exchange and communication.

Utilize Vue.js and Type Script:
Leverage the features and capabilities of Vue.js and Type Script to build modular, reusable, and maintainable frontend components. Utilize Type Script's strong typing system to enhance code quality, catch errors at compile-time, and improve developer productivity.

Bug Fixing and Troubleshooting:
Identify and resolve bugs, issues, and glitches in our applications.

Code Quality:
Maintain code quality, enforce coding standards, and ensure best practices.

Documentation:
Create and maintain technical documentation for applications, code, and processes.

Cross-Platform Testing:
Test applications on various operating systems and troubleshoot compatibility issues.

Qualifications You’re a great fit for this role if you are:

A person that has a constant desire to learn and the ability to learn quickly.

Taking responsibility and ownership.

Are asking questions. Are a great team player!

What will help you thrive? If you:

Have more than 4 years of experience working on web applications.

Have strong knowledge of Type Script and its application within frontend frameworks (ideally vue.js).Create visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces.

Have strong experience with at least one backend framework (.NET, Symfony, Spring).Are proficient in working with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, SQL Server) and No

SQL databases (e.g., Mongo

DB).Care about product management and understanding user needs.

Can communicate in English – both spoken and written - min. B2 level.

Nice-to-have:

Experience with Electron Bonus Points if you:

Have experience in developing desktop applications with Electron.

Have experience working in Dev Ops Culture.

Are familiar with virtualization tools and container orchestration like Docker and Kubernetes. Have experience in developing healthcare applications. Additional Information What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

A salary adequate to your experience and skills between 40.000 and 55.000 euros. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Flexible remuneration and benefits system via…
